__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

formInstallPreview.description: How the bundle's form plugins stand against this server, read before installing: each program key's current program, each document type's existing registry entry and whether installing it would blank the old client's form, and the programs to choose from. Null on an install's result.

installedDocumentTypes.description: What the install did to each form plugin's registry entries: the report the CLI prints, one node per declared type. Null for an uploaded bundle not yet installed, and empty for a bundle with no form plugin.
